title: Utsubora - The Story of a Novelist
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A two-volume literary mystery for adults. A young woman, Aki Fujino, dies in a fall after calling the novelist Shun Mizorogi; a girl who looks exactly like her appears, introducing herself as Aki's twin Sakura. As Mizorogi's past ties to Aki come out, his latest book 'Utsubora' draws plagiarism suspicion, and the story turns on who really wrote it (Otaku USA review; MU and AniList descriptions).
life_message: Lies about authorship and love unravel those who build their lives on them.
